result.title: Denoising Diffusion with Progressive Posterior Sampling
result.summary: Diffusion models provide effective generative priors for solving noisy linear inverse problems. However, existing posterior sampling methods may require singular value decomposition (SVD) of the measurement operator or prior knowledge of the measurement noise variance, while guidance based on local gradients provides only a limited view of posterior geometry. We propose progressive posterior sampling (PPS) with manifold projection, which automatically estimates the measurement noise variance and avoids SVD. During reverse diffusion, PPS constructs a Gaussian approximation to the posterior distribution in closed form and guides a sample drawn from the local prior toward the approximate posterior mean. We then project the guided sample onto a spherical level set that approximates the local noisy image manifold, promoting consistency with the local geometry of the diffusion prior. Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet across four restoration tasks and three measurement noise levels demonstrate competitive reconstruction accuracy and perceptual quality by PPS.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 progressive posterior sampling（PPS）：在反向扩散中用闭式高斯近似后验，引导局部先验样本朝近似后验均值移动，并投影到球面水平集以贴合噪声图像流形，从而在无需 SVD 与噪声方差先验的条件下求解含噪线性逆问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「闭式后验均值引导 + 局部流形投影」的采样状态更新思路，可供核查能否用于 diffusion 式 latent 推理中约束推理状态与先验几何一致；但论文本身面向图像复原，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
